paite: Mangbat ni in TOUPA'N hon dawng hen! Jakob' Pathian min in hon liahkhuh hen!
heading: Lapu Lian A Ding, David La / Vualzohna Ngetna
english: For the Chief Musician. A Psalm by David. May Yahweh answer you in the day of trouble. May the name of the God of Jacob set you up on high,

paite: Mun siangthou a kipan in panpihna hon sawlsak henla, Zion a kipan in hon hihhat hen!
english: send you help from the sanctuary, grant you support from Zion,

paite: Na thillat teng theigige henla, na halmang thillat kipahpih hen! Selah
english: remember all your offerings, and accept your burned sacrifice. Selah.

paite: Na lungtang deihlam hon pia henla, na lunggel tengteng hon lohchingsak hen.
english: May he grant you your heart’s desire, and fulfill all your counsel.

paite: Na hotdamna ah nuam in la ka sa ding ua, ka Pathian min un ka puanzakte uh ka zak lai ding uh! TOUPA'N na ngetnate hon lohchingsak hen!
english: We will triumph in your salvation. In the name of our God, we will set up our banners. May Yahweh grant all your requests.

paite: TOUPA'N athaunilh ahondam chih tu in ka theita; akhut taklam hotdamna tha in avan siangthou a kipan in amah ahon dawng ding hi.
english: Now I know that Yahweh saves his anointed. He will answer him from his holy heaven, with the saving strength of his right hand.

paite: Khenkhatte'n kangtalaite amuang ua, khenkhat in sakolte amuang uh, E'n zaw TOUPA i Pathian min i lou zaw ding hi
english: Some trust in chariots, and some in horses, but we trust in the name of Yahweh our God.

paite: Amau zaw akun un, apukta ua; ei zaw i thou ua, i ding zawta hi.
english: They are bowed down and fallen, but we rise up, and stand upright.

paite: TOUPA, hondam in! I sap chiang in kumpipa'n hon dawng hen.
english: Save, Yahweh! Let the King answer us when we call!
